articles.title: Cboe, S&P Dow Jones may explore tokenized options contracts under extended licensing deal
articles.snippet: The agreement opens the door to tokenized derivatives as some of Wall Street's biggest institutions, including Nasdaq, NYSE and DTCC, move traditional markets onchain.

articles.title: Kakaopay partners with Dinari, Ondo to explore tokenized Korean stocks
articles.snippet: Kakaopay Securities is working with Dinari and Ondo Finance to explore tokenizing Korean-listed equities and expanding their availability to investors in international markets.

articles.title: ECB puts AI agent payments on the digital euro drawing board
articles.snippet: The ECB is seeking firms to explore AI agents and machine-to-machine interactions as it prepares a separate digital euro pilot for 2027.

articles.title: Bitget CEO says $388M hack exploited third-party security vulnerability
articles.snippet: Some stolen assets have been frozen, but Bitget has yet to disclose how much has been recovered as investigators continue to assess a possible North Korea link.

articles.title: OpenAI Gave AI Agents Their Own Computers at DevDay 2026. Here's Everything It Announced
articles.snippet: OpenAI's DevDay launched dots, always-on AI agents with their own computers, plus a cheaper GPT-6.1 Sol and a $500 speed tier. Here's every announcement, explained for people who don't speak AI.
